title: Parts of a Plant | Grade 1 Science for Kids | Little Takhti
description:
Learn the parts of a plant with Takhti: roots, stem, leaves and flower, and the job each part does. Find out which plant parts we eat and what plants need to grow, then try a quick quiz. For Grade 1 children (ages 6 to 7).

Free printable worksheets, quizzes and games for this topic: https://littletakhti.netlify.app/class-1-science-parts-of-a-plant-worksheets/

Chapters
0:00 Parts of a plant
0:16 What each part does
0:40 Parts we eat
0:59 Quiz
1:44 Remember

Little Takhti makes free learning for children in Pakistan, Nursery to Grade 3. https://littletakhti.netlify.app
